clauses.quote: Staffing ratios for Special Education classes and teachers will not exceed the legal maximums.
clauses.subject_text: Staffing ratios for Special Education classes and teachers

clauses.quote: the total number of students shall be the total in both sessions
the total number of students shall be considered as one class

The District shall establish a class size problem resolution committee at each level (elementary, intermediate, and high school) to study and suggest methods of relief in buildings to reduce split-grade classes, to reduce the impact of low enrollment classes, to allow for large group or experimental instruction, and/or team teaching.

The District and Association by May 1, 2000, will conduct a secondary class-by-class/site-by-site assessment based on enrollment figures with a goal of understanding the reasons for class size reductions where educationally and financially feasible.
These figures and the results of this study, along with recommendations if any for secondary class size reduction, will be submitted to the bargaining teams by May 30, 2000.
clauses.subject_text: These figures and the results of this study, along with recommendations if any for secondary class size reduction

clauses.quote: These results and recommendations will be referred back to the bargaining teams
these results and recommendations will be considered for implementation in the 2000-2001 school year
